sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the applicant was appointed as Class-IV employee in the Institution on compassionate grounds.
The applicant is stated to have filed a forged C.C.C. certificate thereby to seek promotion from the said post.
The said C.C.C. certificate on verification was found forged, as such the F.I.R. was instituted against the applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the informant, who happens to be the Principal of the Institute, is inimical to the applicant and has got lodged the present F.I.R.
Even the inquiry report does not indicate any complicity of the applicant, although the applicant was not promoted.

Learned counsel further stated that the appellate authority/D.I.O.S. vide order dated 12.12.2022 had recommended the applicant and had found the allegations false besides giving a finding that the informant seems inimical to the applicant.

Learned counsel next stated that the animosity of the informant is but evident from the fact that against the stay order of the D.I.O.S. concerned, the informant has filed a revision before the Court, which is still pending.
6. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against her.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal history and she is also a pregnant lady.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, she will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.

7. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

8. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98", the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.

11. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

12. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
